scripts.start: adb reverse tcp:8081 tcp:8081 && adb reverse tcp:5000 tcp:5000 && expo start --dev-client -c
scripts.android: adb reverse tcp:8081 tcp:8081 && adb reverse tcp:5000 tcp:5000 && expo run:android
scripts.install:apk: adb push android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk /data/local/tmp/app.apk && adb shell pm install -r --user 0 /data/local/tmp/app.apk
scripts.rebuild:apk: npm run build && cd android && .\gradlew.bat assembleDebug && cd .. && npm run install:apk
